modmenu.descriptionTranslation.ipmask: IPMask hides server addresses in multiplayer menus, including saved server names that contain an address. Addresses are obscured in address fields, the server list, disconnection messages, and screen-reader narration unless revealed for the current screen. This is a client-side privacy aid for streamers and content creators; it does not change saved server data or connection behavior.
modmenu.summaryTranslation.ipmask: Hide server IPs in your server list and never leak them again.
